critiques.assumption: A confirmed weekly course set remains a reliable authority for replacements.
critiques.limitation: D1-O6 establishes heterogeneous timetables; their completeness and update timing are unmeasured. Confirmation may freeze an omission or obsolete split interpretation. This is an untested authority dependency, not an observed manifest failure.
critiques.opening: Make confirmed membership explicitly correctable, with revisions confined to disputed courses.
critiques.comparison: A1 stabilizes membership but may preserve mistakes; Z1 can resolve temporal identity but cannot establish timetable completeness. A correction path addresses a different dependency: revising intended membership after new information.
critiques.probe: Proposed: introduce a late timetable correction after confirmation and compare frozen versus revised membership, including all correction labor.

critiques.assumption: Replacement retries create additional discrepancies and materially increase active handling.
critiques.limitation: D1-O5 supplies turnaround delays, not changing replacement contents; D1-O7 lacks action recordings. The proposed feedback mechanism is unestablished.
critiques.opening: Gate a persistent manifest implementation on evidence of its incremental benefit.
critiques.comparison: Z2 separates active labor from waiting; A1 needs additional evidence that stable membership improves either labor or correctness.
critiques.probe: Proposed: compare baseline, frozen manifest, and correctable manifest on matched fabricated tasks; measure membership errors and active handling separately from waiting.

openings.claim: Reuse confirmed weekly membership until an explicit correction creates a new version.
openings.delta: Add targeted revision to A1 instead of treating one confirmation as permanently authoritative.
openings.prediction: Manifest reuse plus targeted correction should preserve repeatability while recovering late omissions. Unlike the existing generator alone, it retains approved membership; unlike frozen A1, it can amend errors. Their interaction is conditional reuse. Failure boundary: an undetected timetable error remains wrong.
openings.probe: Proposed only: assess one fabricated correction with six coordinators across two short sessions, retaining CSV import and concurrent entry. Count confirmation and revision time. Subsequent evaluation requires the next 40 exports and all original targets.
assumptions: Smallest capability: private staging preview of tenant-scoped course IDs, one correction, and regenerated documented CSV; stable IDs and correction authority require inspection.
Total first change stays within six engineer-days and existing hosting; participant names remain private, center ownership is enforced, and attendance entry continues.
